hooks.name: Verdict changes need a real page
hooks.description: Changing how verdicts are decided must start from a real misjudged page, keep the property invariants and be re-measured on a fresh benchmark seed.

action.prompt: You just changed the verdict logic or lexicon. Follow #verdict-rules: (1) name the real page (URL and live title) that motivated the change and make sure tests/unit/takeover-patterns.test.ts has a regression test quoting it; (2) confirm no property in tests/property/verdict.test.ts was weakened; (3) run `npm test`; (4) if weights changed, say which benchmark seed you will use next. It must not be 2026, 1031, 3110 or 4040, which are already spent.
